title: MONITORING LATENT WORLD STATES IN LANGUAGE MODELS WITH PROPOSITIONAL PROBES

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using templated contexts that specify the genders and stereotypically male or female occupations of two people. The model is either prompted about their genders or internally probed to test if the binding subspace preferentially binds occupation tokens to stereotypical gender tokens, comparing accuracy between pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical contexts.
